purpose: Material-specific interpretation of semantic color roles for upper garments.

behaviors.valueSpacing: moderate, with one stable body midtone and restrained light plane
behaviors.shadowHueShift: slightly cooler or less saturated than the fabric; avoid neutral RGB darkening
behaviors.highlightBehavior: small soft shoulder or upper-chest plane
behaviors.saturationBehavior: primary may be colorful; highlight usually loses a little saturation
behaviors.contrastTopology: quiet fabric mass with neck binding and sleeve edge carrying construction
behaviors.textureBehavior: none or one broad print field; no speckle
behaviors.accentBudget: one compact focal cluster or one broad band

behaviors.valueSpacing: moderate with crisp separation at collar, placket and cuff
behaviors.shadowHueShift: cooler in clean fabrics; warmer deep neutral in rustic fabrics
behaviors.highlightBehavior: short planar highlights on collar, shoulder and pocket flap
behaviors.saturationBehavior: mid saturation supports solids, stripes and checks
behaviors.contrastTopology: construction edges are clearer than interior folds
behaviors.textureBehavior: ordered stripes/checks aligned to fabric fields
behaviors.accentBudget: small pocket, button, tie or collar contrast
avoid: placket isolated as bright center stripe

behaviors.valueSpacing: close to moderate; preserve a broad coherent midtone
behaviors.shadowHueShift: gentle hue drift, commonly cooler or redder depending on story
behaviors.highlightBehavior: soft and sparse; one rib or upper plane rather than sharp edges
behaviors.saturationBehavior: low through moderately colorful; repeats stay within the fabric family
behaviors.contrastTopology: ribbed neck, cuffs and hem share a coherent sub-ramp
behaviors.textureBehavior: stable cables, diamonds or bands with quiet gaps
behaviors.accentBudget: pattern may replace a separate accent

behaviors.valueSpacing: moderate and soft, deeper at gathered terminations
behaviors.shadowHueShift: slightly cool/neutral shadow with material-colored structural dark
behaviors.saturationBehavior: supports pastel, neutral and bright casual colors
behaviors.contrastTopology: neck/cuff/hem ribbing creates repeated value anchors
behaviors.textureBehavior: mostly smooth; graphic or panel is intentional
behaviors.accentBudget: one graphic, pouch block, or sleeve band system

behaviors.valueSpacing: soft primary ramp with clear layer boundary against inner fabric
behaviors.shadowHueShift: deeper/cooler along hanging edges and under overlap
behaviors.highlightBehavior: soft knit-facing edges and upper shoulder
behaviors.saturationBehavior: outer and inner layers may contrast in hue or value but not both maximally by default
behaviors.contrastTopology: two open knit edges, cuffs and hem form one family; inner shirt remains broad

behaviors.valueSpacing: moderate to broad at recesses; durable midtone dominates
behaviors.shadowHueShift: toward indigo, blue-green, brown-violet, or another story-specific deep hue
behaviors.highlightBehavior: restrained edge wear on pocket flap, shoulder and seam intersections
behaviors.saturationBehavior: usually moderate, but not restricted to blue or brown
behaviors.contrastTopology: pockets, yoke, placket and straight hem receive structural darks
behaviors.textureBehavior: large panels and sparse seam cues; no distressed speckle by default
behaviors.accentBudget: small work tab, lining, or stitch contrast

behaviors.valueSpacing: clear mid-to-dark plane separation around overlaps and pockets
behaviors.shadowHueShift: cooler or complementary deep neutral shared across panels
behaviors.highlightBehavior: small firm planes, not glossy streaks
behaviors.saturationBehavior: restrained body with optional localized functional accent
behaviors.contrastTopology: yoke, guarded opening, pockets and cuff form disciplined regions
behaviors.textureBehavior: smooth technical/work fabric with seams as topology
behaviors.accentBudget: one tab/patch/lining accent plus optional muted trim

behaviors.valueSpacing: crisp and broad enough for blocks to survive gameplay scale
behaviors.shadowHueShift: deep cool or chromatic neutral supporting all block colors
behaviors.highlightBehavior: small clean synthetic plane; no metallic shine
behaviors.saturationBehavior: higher saturation allowed in one or two blocks; supporting colors remain controlled
behaviors.contrastTopology: large shoulder/sleeve, side or yoke blocks with clean termination
behaviors.textureBehavior: nearly none; color blocking is the surface system
behaviors.accentBudget: localized bright stripe, zipper pull or small mark
avoid: dark body plus bright center only

behaviors.valueSpacing: moderate shell planes with deeper gathered-band anchors
behaviors.shadowHueShift: cool or violet deep shadow for synthetic shell; warm deep shadow for suede-like story
behaviors.highlightBehavior: rounded shoulder/sleeve plane and restrained shell edge
behaviors.saturationBehavior: primary can be light, bright or dark; ribbing usually quieter
behaviors.contrastTopology: rounded body, contrast lining or sleeves, and collar/cuff/waist triad
behaviors.accentBudget: one patch, lining, or zipper accent

behaviors.valueSpacing: clean hierarchy with clear lapel/outer/inner separation
behaviors.shadowHueShift: deep chromatic neutral; black is not required
behaviors.highlightBehavior: sharp but sparse lapel, collar and shoulder planes
behaviors.saturationBehavior: usually controlled; pale, colorful and dark formal fabrics are all valid
behaviors.contrastTopology: outer body frames a substantial shirt; lapel and pockets use structural darks
behaviors.textureBehavior: minimal; subtle pinstripe or weave only when it remains subordinate
behaviors.accentBudget: tie, pocket accent, buttons or restrained metal—not all
avoid: light shirt reduced to center slit

behaviors.valueSpacing: broad enough to separate nested formal layers while retaining quiet fields
behaviors.shadowHueShift: story-specific chromatic dark shared across the composition
behaviors.highlightBehavior: controlled planes and one focal material highlight
behaviors.saturationBehavior: one signature hue or accent may lead; supporting fabrics step down in saturation
behaviors.contrastTopology: one primary region, one substantial secondary region, one controlled focal accent
behaviors.textureBehavior: sparse brocade, braid or original motif within a bounded field
behaviors.accentBudget: one signature focal system and one restrained echo

globalRules: Material behavior modifies spacing, placement and coverage; it does not select rarity.
Hue-shifted shadows must remain coherent with the story and readable beside the Farmer palette.
Accent coverage is judged in the worn composite, not by raw recipe role count.
Patterns and highlights simplify directionally while preserving material identity.
